conversation_starters.title: 'This is a game changer': Thousands of jobs expected from planned manufacturing facility on San Antonio's southeast side
conversation_starters.summary: The $200 million facility will occupy space at Brooks, the former Air Force base redeveloped into a business district on San Antonio's southeast side, and is expected to open by 2030.
